answer: Random beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop bulk fake identities. Each agent proves work per epoch; the beacon splits the log like a prism and picks 5% for a falcon-swift check. A copied heartbeat fails, freezing the identity as an island cut off from rewards. Running 100 clones costs 100 x 20 = 2,000 credits per epoch, unrepaid by any client. An honest agent pays 20 credits once and keeps full rewards; freeloaders cannot pass free.
